declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Shape comes from tokens, not literals: corners use --radius-sm/-row/-panel/-lg/-control (never a literal radius above 3px); control heights, paddings and gaps use --control-height(-sm), --control-padding-x, --control-gap or the .btn layer. A literal ignores the theme and the density setting (src/renderer/CLAUDE.md, Conventions). A size that is not a control (an illustration, a fixed panel) may disable this line with a reason.
